headline: Judge Says Durk Never Denied Lul Pab Murder in Akademiks Interview
body: Trap Lore Ross reports that a judge stated Durk never denied involvement in Lul Pab's murder during an Akademiks interview, implying that if Durk had denied it, the judge would have allowed the clip to be played. The post highlights the legal tension around the case, with the judge's comment suggesting the interview footage was critical evidence. The post has garnered 1,473 likes and 180 comments.
